name: Fire
notes: h axis +1..+3. Smouldering / Burning / Blazing: 4/8/12% HP at turn start, 2/4/6% per hex crossed; at 2+ on grassy ignites grassy neighbours once per cast. Melts glaze. See design/ELEMENTS.md

name: Water
notes: h axis -1..-3. Damp / Flooded / Deep: +0/+1/+2 move cost (0 when glazed); thunder hits on occupant +10% per intensity; adds 2% HP per intensity to a detonation

name: Ice
notes: Glaze: charged tile locked 2 cycles (decay paused; glazed water walkable). Empty tile: arms a stasis marker (3 cycles). Tile glow is proposed (brief gives none): pale cyan frost. Opposite 'all' = 2.5% resistance per rank to every other element

name: Thunder
notes: Detonate: 5% + 4% per charge point (+2% per water intensity) HP to occupant, half to the six neighbours, x1.5 if glazed; tile erased. Empty tile: arms a fuse marker (3 cycles). Crackling purple

name: Wind
notes: Gale: copies the tile's charge onto the six neighbours at 1 cycle (copies never fire markers or ignite grass; glazed and marked hexes refuse them). Empty tile: arms a gale marker (3 cycles). Swirling green

name: Dark
notes: v axis -1..-3. Gloaming / Deep shadow / Abyss: attacks targeting occupant -7/-14/-21 hit; Abyss also drains 3% HP at turn start. Sinking and swirling

name: Light
notes: v axis +1..+3. First light / Lightfall / Pillar: heals occupant 3/6/9% HP at turn start; attacks targeting occupant +7/+14/+21 hit. Glowing yellow; needs saturation to read on white tiles
